`@rsocko/icon-picker` is MIT licensed. It depends on or retrieves icons from
the projects and services below. This summary is informational; downstream
users are responsible for confirming that their use complies with current
license, service, trademark, and brand requirements.

| Project or service | Use | License / terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [emojilib](https://github.com/muan/emojilib) | Local emoji keyword data | MIT |
| [emoji-picker-react](https://github.com/ealush/emoji-picker-react) | Lazy full emoji browser | MIT |
| [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/license) | Icon set via Iconify | ISC |
| [Material Design Icons](https://pictogrammers.com/docs/general/license/) | Icon set via Iconify | Apache-2.0 |
| [Phosphor Icons](https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core) | Icon set via Iconify | MIT |
| [Iconify API](https://iconify.design/docs/api/) | Search and SVG delivery | Icon sets retain their individual licenses; service terms apply |
| [Dashboard Icons](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons) | App logo catalog and SVG delivery via jsDelivr | MIT; individual logos may be trademarked |
| [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) | Brand catalog and SVG delivery | CC0-1.0 data; brand guidelines and trademarks still apply |
| [jsDelivr](https://www.jsdelivr.com/terms) | Public CDN for catalogs and Dashboard Icons | Service terms apply |

No third-party icon assets are copied into this package. They are requested by
the end user's browser when the corresponding provider is used.
